featured_reviews.name: Muneer Toprani
featured_reviews.review_text: This chemist store has been done at a very useful place and location but sadly their staff really lacks proper communication skills, especially their security guard at the entrance at night. The security guard has so much attitude of his own as if he is not really bothered it interested in your business. He talks and answers for almost everything as if he is doing a favour to you by catering to your need. Yesterday I was suddenly wanted to drink some cold milk sadly in Wadala station area after 11:50pm hardly any shop is open to buy or get any cold or flavoured milk, had no other option so went to NOBEL Chemist here asked him if he had Amul cool milk initially he said whatever is there is there, then I again asked him as their refrigerator outside the store was locked so he opened the lick anf removed me some flavored milk, when I went to the counter to pay off I found some fruit cakes (almost more than 12 to 15 packs) which were last month around 20th April 2019 and the pack very clearly stated best before 18 days from Manufacturing, so I asked the counter staff what is this. Immediately the security guard comes up and says to me this is a running item and gets picked up daily so as a customer we do not have to bother to see the date. I asked the same thing to the counter staff and they also had a blank face and no reply. Today also I went to buy bottled drinking water again the security guard shows attitude saying that we sell branded stuff and not anything that you ask. So the management of NOBEL Chemist if you need to be in business better teach your staff some proper communication skills otherwise be prepared to shut down your store some day.

featured_reviews.name: S H
featured_reviews.review_text:
Me and my elderly parent were here to get some medicines. First of all we were already worried bcos of her diagnosis then suddenly a very pushy and aggressive sales woman started asking us to buy ACV tablets, Glutathione and Weight management tablets from a brand called BioHealth by RMPL Pharma. We politely refused, but she kept badgering us. She body shamed us and said that all my organs are being damaged from the inside because I’m too fat, she said that I don’t look good and that I should lose weight to look better and even made false claims that I would lose 2 kgs in 2 weeks and get thin in no time.

This is supposed to be such a reputable pharmacy. The least they can do is train their sales people to have some sense and sensibility on what to say and how to say it. This was a grossly rude, upsetting and an intrusive experience for us. We should consider holding such people and establishments accountable for trying to scam and hard sell pills and potions to innocent people.

We certainly don’t want to be accosted by seedy pill pushers when visiting a pharmacy. I would never go back here again.
